summary: Implemented the Category-Gated Offers Page plan end-to-end. Backend GET /api/offers now accepts an optional categoryId query param alongside locationId. Mobile app adds useCategories hook, CategoryContext with AsyncStorage persistence, updated useOffers to require both location and category, CategoryPicker component, and a gated Offers tab that always shows LocationBar at top while requiring category selection before offers load. Users can change category via a compact bar with Change action.
current_status: Offers tab is category-gated with persisted selection. Backend filters offers by locationId and categoryId. All five plan todos are complete. Ready for manual testing on device/simulator.
